assignments.name: JobRequirment

parameters.text:
=You are a Senior Technical HR Recruiter. Evaluate the candidate below against the job requirements and return a fair, evidence-based JSON result.

# CANDIDATE DATA
Name: {{ $('Get row(s) in sheet').item.json.name }}
Email: {{ $('Get row(s) in sheet').item.json.email }}
Applied Position: {{ $('Get row(s) in sheet').item.json.position }}
Motivation: {{ $('Get row(s) in sheet').item.json.motivation || 'Not provided' }}

Extracted CV data (experience, education, skills, certificates):
{{ JSON.stringify($json.output) }}

Full CV text:
{{ $('Prepare Application').item.json.text }}

# JOB REQUIREMENTS
{{ $('Prepare Application').item.json.JobRequirment }}

# RULES
- Use ONLY information found in the CV data. Never invent skills, experience, projects, or certificates.
- Evaluate only what is relevant to the applied position.
- University, personal, and training projects are NOT professional experience. Internships and freelance count only if explicitly documented.
- Don't penalize entry-level candidates just for having no professional experience.
- Ongoing courses/diplomas are not completed qualifications.
- Missing info = 'not mentioned', not 'cannot do it'.
- Never judge by name, gender, age, nationality, or religion.
- Apply the same standards to every candidate for the same position.

# SCORING (total 100, integer)
- Technical skills: 40 (required skills 30, bonus skills 5, evidence of practical use 5)
- Professional experience: 20 (0 if none documented)
- Education & training: 10 (relevant degree up to 5, completed courses/certs up to 3, ongoing education up to 2)
- Projects: 20 (relevance 5, complexity 5, personal contribution 5, results 5)
- Motivation: 10 (interest in role 4, career goals 3, specific motivation 3)
Don't award unsupported points. Don't penalize the same weakness twice.

# RECOMMENDATION (lowercase, exactly one of these)
- score >= 70 -> interview
- score 50-69 -> maybe
- score < 50 -> reject

# FIELD INSTRUCTIONS
- matched_requirements: array of job requirements the CV clearly supports. Add the short evidence in the same string when possible, e.g. Bachelor's in Computer Science (Cairo University, 2025).
- missing_requirements: array of job requirements NOT shown in the CV, e.g. Docker (not mentioned).
- strengths: ONE string, 2-3 sentences, specific and evidence-based.
- concerns: ONE string, 1-2 sentences, specific. Empty string if none.
- yearsExperience: number, documented professional experience only (decimals allowed, e.g. 1.83). Use null if it can't be calculated reliably. Use 0 only if the CV clearly shows none.
- topSkills: ONE string, comma-separated, max 6 skills most relevant to the position.
- interview_questions: array of EXACTLY 3 strings. Each must be technical, specific to this candidate's CV (mention their projects/tools), and match their real level. One about a project they built, one about a core required skill, one about a gap in missing_requirements. No generic HR questions.

# OUTPUT
Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown, no text outside the JSON, exactly this structure:

{
  "name": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "position": "string",
  "score": 0,
  "recommendation": "interview | maybe | reject",
  "matched_requirements": [],
  "missing_requirements": [],
  "strengths": "string",
  "concerns": "string",
  "interview_questions": ["string", "string", "string"],
  "yearsExperience": 0,
  "topSkills": "string"
}

Before answering, check: score is an integer 0-100, recommendation matches the score range, interview_questions has exactly 3 items, and no extra fields exist.

parameters.subject: Congratulations! Your Application Has Been Accepted 🎉
parameters.message:
=Dear {{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.name || 'Candidate' }},

Great news! 🎉

We are excited to inform you that your application for the {{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.position || 'position' }} has been successfully accepted, and you have been shortlisted for the interview stage!

Congratulations on reaching this stage. We were impressed by your profile and look forward to learning more about your skills, experience, and potential.

Our HR team will contact you soon with further details about your interview, including the date, time, and format.

Get ready for the next step. We look forward to meeting you!

Best regards,
Human Resources Team

parameters.subject: Update on Your Job Application
parameters.message:
=Dear {{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.name || 'Candidate' }},

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the {{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.position || 'position' }} at our company and for your interest in joining our team.

After carefully reviewing your application, we regret to inform you that we will not be moving forward with your application at this time.

We appreciate your effort and the time you invested in the application process. We encourage you to apply for future opportunities that match your skills and experience.

We wish you the very best in your career and future endeavors.

Best regards,
Human Resources Team
